name: Bloodlord Mandokir
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/zul-gurub/mandokir.md: Era 466,340 HP, Ohgan 91,560, 20-man. Single event-driven fight, modelled as three phases: Ohgan alive (kill him first, the guides' default), the 90 s Enrage after Ohgan dies, then the burn. Cadences for Charge, Gaze, Whirlwind and Fear are estimates; Mortal Strike and Sunder intervals are from the sources. Boss melee (320 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. Ohgan's Enrage (+50% damage, +65% attack speed for 90 s) is a non-dispellable tank debuff that raises damage taken by 60% for the phase, because the engine has one enrage flag. Threatening Gaze is modelled in two parts. The real mechanic, a 6 s debuff on a random player who must stop everything that makes threat or be charged for a lethal Guillotine, is a `debuff` with `forbidAbilities`: any press while it is on you costs 12,000 (a placeholder: DBC weapon + 7,500, the wiki says about 15,000) and is scored as `gazeBroken`; walking is safe (cmangos punishes only a rise in the target's threat; Wowhead says any action). Separately, when he watches the tank, everyone must stop attacking: that is a `shield` on all DPS for 6 s, where every attack costs a reflected hit and counts in `attacksIntoShield`, since the sim has no player-held threat to punish on the tank. Charge is a `threatWipe` with `teleportBossTo` the bait spot (the threat wipe and target switch from the guidance are one action here, because the wipe already throws him at the raid and a second switch would only burn the tank's Taunt). DPS stop until the tank has him back; the real hunters Feign Death after the charge, which is not modelled. Whirlwind is a 2 s cast `aoe` with moveOut for melee. Intimidating Shout fears melee within 8 yd. Level Up is the engine's `enrage` (multiplier 1.1, one step), fired once at a fixed time because the real trigger is three player deaths, which the engine cannot count across the raid. Chained Spirits and Revive are not modelled; a real raid that wipes down people will see more levels. Overpower and Execute are not modelled. Ohgan is a killable killFirst add with a 70 s lifetime, held by the off-tank role; the two-tank Sunder swap at 3-5 stacks has no representation here because the add has no abilities. The Vilebranch Speaker pull trigger is not modelled.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him at the pillar, Taunt him back after every Charge and walk him home before the DPS restart. If you are watched, press nothing for 6 s; walking is safe.

offtank.label: Ohgan off-tank
offtank.description: Your job is Ohgan: pick him up as he rides in and hold him far from Mandokir while the raid kills him first.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Ohgan dies first, then Mandokir. Stand at his feet so you are not a Charge target, walk out of Whirlwind a second early, and stop attacking for 6 s if he watches you (walking is safe).

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Kill Ohgan first, then Mandokir, from long range (past the 8 to 30 yd Charge band). Stop the moment he watches the tank, and stop after every Charge until the tank has him back.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Pre-heal the tank for Mortal Strike. During the Enrage everything goes on the tank. If he watches you, stop casting for 6 s.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Removes the oldest dispellable debuff on the raid. One button here stands in for Dispel Magic, Cleanse, Decurse and Cure Poison.

ohgan.label: Ohgan
ohgan.tip: His raptor. Off-tank takes him far from Mandokir and the raid kills him first. His Sunder Armor stacks, so tanks swap at 3-5.

charge.label: Charge
charge.tip: He charges a raid member between 8 and 40 yd away and the whole threat table goes. Stop attacking until the tank has him back at the pillar.

threateningGaze.label: Threatening Gaze
threateningGaze.tip: Stop attacking, casting and healing for 6 s. Anything that makes threat gets you charged and killed. Walking is safe.

gazeOnTank.label: He is watching the tank
gazeOnTank.toast: He is watching the tank: STOP ATTACKING
gazeOnTank.tip: He has the tank under his gaze. Everyone stops attacking for 6 s, or the threat table flips.

whirlwind.label: Whirlwind
whirlwind.tip: Melee, walk out of the spin a second before it lands. Each tick is around 2,500.

intimidatingShout.label: Intimidating Shout
intimidatingShout.tip: Fears everyone within 8 yd. Melee, stay at his feet in small numbers.

mortalStrike.label: Mortal Strike
mortalStrike.tip: A heavy hit on the tank and -50% healing received for 5 s. Pre-heal it.

ohganEnrage.label: Ohgan's death: Enrage
ohganEnrage.tip: Ohgan is dead and Mandokir goes berserk for 90 s: +50% damage, +65% attack speed.

levelUp.label: Level Up
levelUp.tip: Every 3 raid deaths he gains a level: +10% damage, permanently. Do not feed him.

expectations.label: Hold him at the pillar
expectations.tip: Taunt him and walk him to the pillar, away from the raid.

expectations.label: Taunt him back after each Charge
expectations.tip: He teleports to the bait and the table is empty. Taunt, then walk him home.

expectations.label: Pick up Ohgan
expectations.tip: He rides in with his master. Take him to your spot, 30 yards away from Mandokir.

expectations.label: Keep Ohgan off the raid
expectations.tip: A loose raptor in the healers is a disaster.

expectations.label: Ohgan first
expectations.tip: Kill Ohgan before Mandokir. Every attack on Mandokir while he lives is the kill order broken.

expectations.label: Stop when he watches the tank
expectations.tip: For the 6 s of the Gaze, not a single attack. Then pick up again.

expectations.label: Press nothing while he watches you
expectations.tip: Stop everything for the 6 s of the Gaze.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Pre-heal Mortal Strike
expectations.tip: A 5 s -50% healing window on the tank every 20-40 s. Heal before it lands.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Charges and Mortal Strike are the danger now. Keep the tank high.

phases.name: Enrage
phases.subtitle: Ohgan is dead, 90 s of berserk

expectations.label: Taunt him back after each Charge
expectations.tip: Every second he is off you he is running at the raid. Taunt.

expectations.label: Reposition near the tank
expectations.tip: Ohgan is dead. Stay close enough to be useful if the main tank drops.

expectations.label: Stop when he watches the tank
expectations.tip: A tank who loses aggro now is a wipe.

expectations.label: Press nothing while he watches you
expectations.tip: Stop everything for the 6 s of the Gaze.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Step out of Whirlwind
expectations.tip: You have 2 s of warning. Use it.

expectations.label: All heals on the tank during Enrage
expectations.tip: +50% damage and +65% attack speed for 90 s. Nothing else matters.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Enrage: all heals on the tank.

expectations.label: Taunt him back after each Charge
expectations.tip: Keep on it until he falls.

expectations.label: Stop when he watches the tank
expectations.tip: Do not throw it away at the end.

expectations.label: Press nothing while he watches you
expectations.tip: Stop everything for the 6 s of the Gaze.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Step out of Whirlwind
expectations.tip: Every hit you stand in is another bandage you do not have.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Mortal Strike windows keep coming.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Keep the tank alive to the end.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

gazeBroken.label: Actions while watched
gazeBroken.tip: Stop everything for the 6 s of the Gaze.

attacksIntoShield.label: Attacks while the tank was watched
attacksIntoShield.tip: When he watches the tank, stop attacking for the full 6 s.

cues.notes: Taunt after each Charge, the off-tank grabs Ohgan, Heal the tank.

list.label: Taunt when Mandokir turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Grab Ohgan
list.tip: Run to him and Taunt him away.

drills.name: Charge and return
drills.description: He Charges every 15 s and the table wipes. Taunt, then walk him home to the pillar.

drills.name: Ohgan pickup
drills.description: Pick up Ohgan and hold him away from everyone.

drills.name: Stop on the Gaze
drills.description: He watches the tank every 12 s. Stop attacking for the full 6 s, then pick straight back up.

drills.name: Whirlwind footwork
drills.description: Walk out of every Whirlwind and come straight back.

drills.name: Mortal Strike and Enrage healing
drills.description: Keep the tank alive through Mortal Strike windows and the 90 s berserk.

limitations: Threatening Gaze does not check every action the real fight watches. Player deaths do not level up Mandokir.
